addons.name: Worry Free Plus
addons.description: Cancel for any reason up to 3 hours before departure
addons.why: The most-chosen add-on for February bookings made this far ahead.
addons.sentence: Worry Free Plus is 119 dollars per person, 238 dollars for the two of you, and lets you cancel for any reason up to 3 hours before departure.

addons.name: Private Transfers
addons.description: Round trip, airport to resort, private vehicle instead of shared shuttle
addons.why: Skips the shared shuttle, which can add over an hour on arrival.
addons.sentence: Private transfers are 140 dollars per person, 280 dollars for the two of you, round trip, and skip the shared shuttle.

addons.name: Premium Cabin
addons.description: Premium seating at the front of the WestJet aircraft, extra legroom and priority boarding
addons.why: New for winter 2026-27 on WestJet sun routes.
addons.sentence: Premium cabin is 199 dollars per person, 398 dollars for the two of you, for premium seating at the front of the WestJet aircraft.
